{{Top|leg}}
'''''Bends''''' was a popular newsfeed amongst the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] citizens of [[Morjanssik]], on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. A highly pro-Quarren newsfeed, it was said to keep young Quarren angry and belligerent by many [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].
